# V2 input provenance

- `replay_fast_01.vec` is generated by `tools/generate_v2_input_replay.py` from the existing `tools/capture_fast_01.csv` hex XYZ capture, followed by eight explicit synthetic rows covering unsigned sensor boundaries, Z>36000, invalid, saturation, gap and sequence wrap.
- Synthetic rows are tagged in the generator source; they are not presented as hardware captures.
- ModelSim file-driven replay is `sim/tb_v2_input_replay.sv`.
